C1567.title: Academic Research Reveals DNS Hijacking Attacks on DApp Frontends
C1567.summary: An academic paper on Web3 software supply chain security identifies DNS hijacking as a critical attack vector for DApps. Attackers can redirect users to malicious frontends via DNS hijacking, replacing transaction addresses or injecting malicious code without user awareness, directly threatening asset security. The study validates DApp frontend hijacking risks from an academic perspective.
